attempt_topology: BACKEND_PAYLOAD_CONTRACT.attempt_identity_v3 is mandatory for every lifecycle branch, source owner, failure and capture. It preserves original exact J/G/R, argv/model/source/native/channel/closure policy.
deadline_derivation: Let S be H-observed actual original worker start, D the unchanged MatchedSchedule.duration_ns, L the immutable launch latest_launch_ns+D bound and E the unchanged original evidence cutoff. Original Attempt.run_deadline R=S+D<=L<=common_cutoff<=original run deadline. WorkerLaunchAck carries S,R,E from that actual attempt. With positive selected initialization I and shutdown Q, require I+Q<D before either launch. Set generation_deadline G=R-Q, initialization_deadline J=min(S+I,G), shutdown_deadline R. BackendAttempt fields and H BackendAdmissionAck must equal these exact values. Initialization readiness <=J, H admission <G, every generation response finishes <=G, planned server shutdown and worker-owned closure/publication/natural exit finish <=R. H later evidence capture uses original E only. Checked original-clock integer arithmetic; no retry-based/readiness-based origin, added allowance or renewed clock.
failure_records: Before successful initialization, its success-only record stays absent. BackendClosure may be failed/unknown with nullable unavailable group/socket/stream/exit observations; all live/ambiguous original handles remain privately owned. BackendExchangeObservation permits a null started_ns when the initial clock failed. A complete variant requires every exact successful observation, no raw error/unknown state and original deadline joins. If any record publication fails, DevelopmentFailure may also have null Pins, while actual private error/handle custody remains; no serialized failure is required to be manufactured. New mandatory pre-base and failed-snapshot branches are in attempt_identity_v3; failure still retains actual live/unknown ownership with no fabricated future Pin.
initialization_evidence: The upstream listener starts before load_model. load_model initializes fresh slots and disables prompt cache when cache_ram=0. /health also exists during sleep; sleep is disabled. /slots is serviced by the model task queue after main initialization/signal registration. These source facts plus actual fresh process/qualified isolation and exact observations support the future proof; endpoint JSON by itself does not measure empty KV memory or provide native qualification.
